column1: dose            mg          This represents the amount of drug entering the system in mg.
A1              mg          Refers to how much drug is in the central compartment in a 2-compartment system.
A2              mg          Refers to how much drug is in the peripheral compartment in a 2-compartment system.
C               mg/L        How much of the drug is in every single liter
Time            s           The time the drug enters the system and how long it takes to be eliminated
Volume          L           How much volume is in the drug in A1 and A2
CL              L/s         The rate that the volume exits the system entirely
Q               L/s         The rate that the drug flows through the intercompartments A1 and A2
